decision_policy: Base owns canonical user, tenant, workspace, membership, session persistence and entitlement meaning; providers contribute facts through replaceable seams.
No provider SDK or service is added in this packet. Every dependency requires an exact PM amendment.
A selected future adapter is not installed, configured, executed, qualified or admitted.
Licence evidence is scoped exactly to the observed top-level repository record. Badge-only and unverified transitive licences remain explicit.
Provider configuration is never runtime evidence; read models expose fixture, configured-unverified, observed and unavailable states.

selected.authority: Base-owned canonical user/tenant/workspace/membership/session records with BASE-SAAS-SOL retaining login, selection, capability and assertion authority

decisions.default: Persist opaque provider and subject references behind the Base identity model; never make provider organizations or roles the canonical tenant/workspace model.

maturity.evidence: Better Auth observed 2026-08-27 with 29,711 stars, pushed that day, not archived, tests/docs/CI visible.
maturity.limits: No package, API, organization-plugin, security, migration, tenancy or revocation spike ran in this lane.

decisions.hosting_implications: Better Auth is a library, so Base owns its deployment, database, migrations and incident surface. Provider replacement must preserve Base IDs and external identity links.
decisions.replacement_seam: External provider key + opaque subject maps to a Base user; session persistence and tenant/workspace membership remain provider-neutral.
decisions.implemented_in_slice: Canonical persistence records and fail-closed read spine only; no credential handling, login UI, assertion minting or provider SDK.

decisions.implemented_in_slice: Schema, constraints, RLS policies and source contracts; no database connection or execution.

decisions.default: Migration 0001 is dependency-free SQL. Drizzle may later map Actionist-owned tables but cannot own donor schemas or replace RLS.

maturity.limits: Historical API churn noted; no current package compatibility or migration execution checked.

decisions.hosting_implications: RLS behavior is database-native and survives ORM replacement. Migration runner choice must preserve ordered checksums, transactional safety and one owner.
decisions.replacement_seam: PlatformStore is the only source-code boundary; SQL schema is authoritative for this bounded slice.
decisions.implemented_in_slice: Raw SQL migration and repository port; no Drizzle import or manifest edit.

selected.authority: Base-owned billing event facts and entitlement grants

decisions.default: Stripe customer/subscription/event identifiers are opaque provider facts. Only active Base entitlement grants authorize product capability; configuration or webhook receipt alone never does.

maturity.evidence: Local finance research records an earlier real Stripe/RevenueCat subscription, payment-event and entitlement/quota precedent.
maturity.limits: The cited source checkout was absent; no direct source, SDK, account, webhook, signature, retry or reconciliation check occurred.

decisions.hosting_implications: Stripe is not self-hostable. Provider replacement is feasible only because Base IDs, idempotent events and grants do not use Stripe objects as canonical authority.
decisions.replacement_seam: Opaque billing provider/account/subscription/event references feed Base-owned facts; entitlement reads are provider-neutral.
decisions.implemented_in_slice: Billing account, event and entitlement schema plus read decisions; no checkout, portal, webhook handler or mutation command.

decisions.default: Provider-neutral bucket, object key, checksum, size, content type, retention and tenant namespace; never persist provider credentials in platform records.

decisions.default: A deployment receipt must bind image digest, migration set, config version, secret-reference version, backup precondition and rollback horizon. Image rollback alone is insufficient.

maturity.evidence: Kamal observed active, 14.5k stars, pushed 2026-08-12 and used by its maintainers in production.
maturity.limits: No image, Dockerfile, host, registry, SSH action, deploy or rollback exists in this packet.

decisions.hosting_implications: Kamal requires owned servers, SSH, image registry, proxy, TLS and operator responsibility. Its default rollback does not restore secrets or database state.
decisions.replacement_seam: Versioned composition manifest and deployment receipt, not a Kamal-specific command API.

selected.database_default: PostgreSQL logical backup for portability plus WAL/PITR contract for recovery

decisions.default: Every backup set binds database identity/version, migration head, tenant scope, object manifest, encryption/key reference, timestamps, retention and checksum. Restore must target a disposable environment first and produce read-back evidence.

maturity.evidence: PostgreSQL is selected; P14 established that rollback must name database/config/external side effects separately.
maturity.limits: No backup tool was sufficiently source-verified in the available local packet, so none is selected by name.

decisions.hosting_implications: Self-hosting owns schedule, WAL archive, encryption, off-host retention, monitoring and restore drills; managed hosting still requires export and independent restore evidence.
decisions.replacement_seam: BackupSet and RestoreReceipt contracts remain independent of the operator tool.
